title: Nucleic Acids Extraction from Single Cell Using MasterPure Complete DNA Purification
author: Sarah Romac

steps.title: Isolate Protist Cells
steps.instruction: Isolate individual protist cells (at least 50µm in length) using a glass bent micropipette under a binocular microscope.

steps.title: Wash and Transfer Cells
steps.instruction: Wash each cell and transfer them into a sterile microtube.

substeps.instruction: Wash each cell in three successive baths of 0.22µm-filtered and sterile seawater
Transfer cells into a 1.5mL sterile microtube

steps.title: Initial Lysis and Storage
steps.instruction: Add lysis buffer to the cells and store.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 μL of lysis buffer (Tissue and Cell Lysis Solution from MasterPureTM DNA and RNA Purification Kit, Epicenter)
Store at -20°C

steps.title: Pellet Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells to remove supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 2 min at Vmax
Discard the supernatant, leaving approximately 25-30 µL of liquid

steps.title: Prepare Proteinase K Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a Proteinase K dilution for each sample.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 1 µL of Proteinase K in 300 µL of Tissue and Cell lysis solution
Vortex for 10 sec to resuspend cells (optional)

steps.title: Cell Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Lysis the cells using the Proteinase K mix and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL of the Proteinase K + lysis solution mix to each sample
Vortex
Incubate for 15 min at 65°C and 1000 rpm
Place samples on ice for 3-5 min

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with MPC Reagent
steps.instruction: Add MPC reagent and centrifuge to form a pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 µL MPC reagent to 300 µL of lysed sample
Vortex
Spin for 10 min at 11,000 g at 4°C
If no pellet is visible, add an additional 25 µL MPC buffer and spin again for 10 min at 11,000 g at 4°C

steps.title: Separate Supernatant and Pellet
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new tube and handle the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant into a new clean 1.5 mL microtube
Discard the pellet (Alternatively, to keep the skeleton: keep the tube with the pellet, add 500 µL MilliQ Water, and store at -20°C)
Add 500 µL of Isopropanol
Mix by inversion
Spin for 10 min at Vmax at 4°C
Carefully discard the supernatant without touching the pellet
Add 500 µL of 70% Ethanol
Mix gently by supporting the tube (do not vortex)
Spin for 5 min at Vmax at 4°C
Carefully discard as much supernatant as possible without touching the pellet

steps.title: Dry and Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and elute the nucleic acids.

substeps.instruction: Let dry at room temperature for 5-10 min until the pellet becomes transparent
Elute in 25 µL of TE1x buffer
Vortex and spin briefly
Store at -80°C
